question: In the AAIB Poole accident, did the Matrice 210 V1 return home after losing its link as the manual describes?

intake.reason: Assess what manuals/incident reports say about loss of control link and whether the aircraft would/does return to home per guidance, in the context of the AAIB Poole incident.

brief.short_answer: FAA guidance says reestablish the control link and, if not possible, start emergency procedures; it notes loss-of-link hazards and requires preflight control-link procedures. The Matrice 210 V1 manual: Failsafe RTH triggers after three seconds of signal loss; the craft retraces home, then hovers 0.7 m above ground awaiting confirmation. Incident reports claim RTH activated but ineffective, wind or pitch prevented return, and auto-land led to a collision. Gaps: no verified evidence that Poole followed the procedures; Home Point status and wind conditions are unverified; model attribution is unclear.

claims.text: AC 107-2A states that when a hazard occurs, 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft'; if the connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.
claims.quote: Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft.
conditions: If the connection cannot be reestablished

claims.text: AC 107-2A states an example hazard scenario: 'Loss of control link over people' to illustrate hazard scenarios.
claims.quote: Loss of control link over people

claims.text: AC 107-2A states that preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures: 'The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.'
claims.quote: The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.

claims.text: According to the manual, Failsafe RTH is activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds, provided the Home Point is recorded and the compass is functioning normally, and the aircraft will retrace its route home.
claims.quote: Failsafe RTH will be automatically activated if the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds.
conditions: remote controller signal lost for more than three seconds

claims.text: When RTH is triggered, the aircraft will ascend to the pre-set RTH attitude and then fly to the Home Point, and will hover 0.7 m above ground waiting for user confirmation.
claims.quote: The aircraft will hover 0.7 m above ground and wait for confirmation from the user.
conditions: hover 0.7 m above ground awaiting user confirmation

claims.text: The reporter states: When communications are lost the UA would normally enter a ‘Failsafe RTH’ mode, but it could not return home due to the wind and limited pitch attitude.
claims.quote: When communications are lost the UA would normally enter a ‘Failsafe RTH’ mode, but it could not return home due to the wind and limited pitch attitude.

claims.text: The reporter states: The UA drifted beyond visual line of sight and communication was lost; Conditions: drift beyond visual line of sight; communication was lost.
claims.quote: The UA drifted beyond visual line of sight and communication was lost which meant that a recovery was no longer possible.
conditions: drift beyond visual line of sight

claims.text: The reporter states: "RTH then appeared to activate but the aircraft did not move any closer" (conditions: RTH initiated but not effective).
claims.quote: RTH then appeared to activate but the aircraft did not move any closer

claims.text: The reporter states: After communication was lost, the UA entered an auto-land mode but it was unable to avoid colliding with a wall.
claims.quote: After communication was lost, the UA entered an auto-land mode but it was unable to avoid colliding with a wall.

gaps.text: Manual states Failsafe RTH retraces route home; incident reports claim it could not return home due to wind and limited pitch attitude.
Manual describes RTH activations with hover 0.7 m above ground awaiting confirmation; incident reports say RTH appeared to activate but did not move closer.
Matrice 210 is not in the approved collection, so the brief does not cover it.
No verified evidence in the supplied claims about whether Poole incident followed preflight control link loss procedures.
No verified evidence about Home Point recording status in the Poole incident.
Unclear whether wind and environmental conditions fully explain RTH failure versus manual expectations.

C001.rationale: The cited passage contains the exact phrases: 'Try to reestablish control link connection with the small unmanned aircraft' and 'If connection cannot be reestablished, start emergency or contingency procedures for loss of control link.'

C002.rationale: The cited passage includes the example 'Loss of control link over people' as part of hazard examples.

C003.rationale: The cited passage states 'The preflight briefing must include control link loss procedures.' as part of the guidance.

C004.rationale: The cited passage states Failsafe RTH activates if the Home Point was recorded and the compass is functioning normally, when the remote controller signal is lost for more than three seconds, and that the aircraft will plan its return route and retrace its original flight route home.

C005.rationale: The cited passages describe RTH leading to ascent to the pre-set RTH attitude, then flying to the Home Point, and hovering at 0.7 m above ground awaiting user confirmation.

C006.rationale: The cited passage states that when communications are lost the UA would normally enter a 'Failsafe RTH' mode and that it could not return home due to wind and limited pitch attitude.

C007.rationale: The cited passage states the UA drifted beyond visual line of sight and that communication was lost, aligning with the claim.

C008.rationale: The cited passage states: 'RTH then appeared to activate but the aircraft did not move any closer.' It also describes that the RTH feature was activated but did not appear to engage, aligning with the claim's condition that RTH was initiated but not effective.

C009.rationale: The cited passage states that after communication was lost the UA entered auto-land and could not avoid colliding with a wall, as claimed.
